mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying mainly clear skies with a temperature of 81 degrees that feels like 80 over Harriet Park, and with a lovely waxing crescent moon tonight, be sure to look northwest at 9:31 PM to catch a brilliant six-minute viewing of the International Space Station.

In city sustainability news, Verona is making it easy to go green with the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop for local apartment composting, and the city continues to focus on green transportation by implementing anti-idling technology on its new ambulance.

Our local calendar is packed with upcoming events, starting July 19th with live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Louie, the annual Mount Horeb Art Fair on July 18th and 19th, and the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market coming to Hometown Junction Park on July 22nd.

In the weekly police report, on Friday, July 10th, Verona officers and K9 Drea conducted a successful traffic stop on an equipment violation, resulting in the alert and seizure of marijuana from a Beaver Dam driver.

For dessert, satisfy your sweet tooth with the rich and classic Turtle flavor of the day at Culver's, featuring creamy vanilla fresh frozen custard swirled with hot fudge, hot caramel, and toasted pecans. They are open until 10 PM tonight, and tomorrow's flavor will be Dark Chocolate PB Crunch.
